policy: Only exact sourcePath + displayed original Latin incipit unlocks the shared Bible Context capsule.
The liturgical Latin and actual Proper owner remain independent from the separate Bible-edition rights and verse equivalence policies.
Each original-file witnessUrl points to the exact Divinum Officium Latin Tempora Proper, not merely a directory homepage.
Historical pre-1960 source variants can coexist in upstream files: publication of dates, classes and rite choices is owned by the separate 1962 calendar/Mass resolver, not this Scripture index.
Discontinuous biblical sections have distinct segmented-register owners; missing or redirected files must fail closed and cannot be guessed.
Unpublished texts, procession readings, optional branch state and local translation texts remain outside this batch.

A resumed Epiphany alias inherits biblical reading content only from its explicit source-owner pointer; the 1960 Code of Rubrics §18 and 1962 Calendar own when the resumed Proper is selected. Never deduce celebration from the alias's name.

All references must preserve precise verse starts and discontinuities. Ten Pentecost Sunday sources (X–XIX) were checked against a separate published witness; 2 initial boundaries were repaired; review file: data/mass/scripture-temporal-sunday-second-witness-audit.v1.json.

All 23 post-Pentecost Sunday identities II–XXIV and 46 reading citation boundaries were compared to separate published 1962 evidence; two verse-boundary mistakes were corrected previously. This is not full textual or liturgical editorial certification.

Other seasons: exact original Latin labels and separately published 1962 digital boundaries were reconciled for 23 source paths / 46 reading slots, with explicit first Advent and Septuagesima secondary-page contamination/omission cautions. Publication is not evidence of independent original transcription; see scripture-other-season-sunday-second-witness-audit.v1.json.
